critical_code_review_comments: services/house_rules.py uses an in-process 30s TTL cache (_CACHE) — multi-worker deployments will have inconsistent reads for up to 30s after a save. Acceptable for a single-pod preview but worth a note for prod with >1 backend pod (eventual consistency).

PUT /admin/house-rules returns {'ok': true, 'house_rules': {...}} but GET returns the doc directly at the top level. Inconsistent shape — both should match (frontend handles it, but external consumers / pytest had to special-case).
